{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '---' while note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a case depth of 0.8–1.2 mm, but neither defines the manufacturing stage (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding). This ambiguity can cause the shop to apply heat treatment at the wrong point in the process, leading to distortion or scrapped parts. The designer should update the heat treatment field and add the required processing stage to note N3.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat treatment field from '---' to reference note N3, and revise note N3 to state when the case hardening is to be performed relative to machining operations."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D7","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 50 H7 +0.025"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D23","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"MATERIAL: 20mNcR5
FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)
MACHINING:
WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"Dimensions D7 (⌀ 8 H7), D14 (⌀ 50 H7 +0.025), and D23 (⌀ 6 H7) are tight ISO fits on a part that note N4 requires to be plated (I.Z.B.P. trivalent zinc plating), yet no allowance for plating thickness is specified on these sizes. Plating buildup will shift the bore diameters out of their H7 tolerance zones, preventing mating shafts or pins from assembling correctly. The designer should either specify pre-plate machining limits that account for the coating thickness or add a note requiring re-machining/masking of these bores after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add plating-thickness allowances to the tolerances of D7, D14, and D23, or add a note specifying that these bores must be masked during plating or re-machined to H7 after plating."}]}
